notes.title: April 12th, 0.53v - Troops, Saving stats, Achievements, New UI, Research...
notes.content:
So much has been added. Regular updates have been added to playtest however not to the main page. 

Here is the long list of updates that has happened on the playtest since the last update on the main slime wars page.

[list]
[*] Added all enemy slimes to the game
[*] Added early access banner
[*] Redesigned Queue UI (Smaller, removed number of units queued)
[*] Redesigned Main Menu
[*] Redesigned Win Screen
[*] Added a shop where you can buy early access banner and support the team in the game dev journey
[*] Added Achievements
[*] Fixed Data Saving
[*] Added research Tab (Not functional just yet)
[*] Added canons and upgrades to canons
[*] Added Exp
[*] Redesigned Lumber camp
[*] Changed enemy spawn rates
[/list]
